title: A Noise-Invariant Determinism Theorem for Multi-Base Post-Processing in Shor's Order Finding
description: Five theorems on classical post-processing of multi-base order-finding measurements in Shor's algorithm: (1) noise-invariant determinism, (2) logarithmic coverage time, (3) exact noise scaling 1/g_M(η), (4) conditional compatibility with Regev's 2023 multi-base framework, and (5) a hybrid (C) + Regev b-trick factoring algorithm with closed-form bound matching empirical mean within 4%. Verified across 17,700 measurements at six composite sizes. Additionally documents a small (~1-3%) phase-noise-induced reduction in run count at sub-Regev-optimal d, a weak instance of stochastic resonance in multi-base quantum factoring under an 'anti-optimization' regime (effect coexists only with sacrificed efficiency). Companion code is ~700 lines of numpy with no quantum libraries required.
